lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with increased spatial separation observed in the central lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible rectilinear grid across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance upper pixels to low-luminance shadowed lower pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance circular spots bounded within the darker silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located towards the anterior and basal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark concentric arc-shaped pigmentation feature is visible on the upper distal portion of the first dorsal fin.
